correctness.rationale: Proof covers every integer n>=3, with full root-leaf exclusion for sets of at least three, an if-and-only-if gap criterion including shortest path ties, a weight-preserving per-site counting bijection, and exact marked-root/pair/triple derivation of every coefficient. The elementary gap bounds show nonadjacent eligible sites cannot coexist for k>=4, and all k=3 corrections are counted. A separate direct all-pairs shortest-path checker exhaustively tested every subset for n=3,...,9 (349504 subsets), and independent index-set enumeration matches the closed finite sums through n=16. Finite tests are not offered as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The 2024 foundation provides general-position polynomial definitions, generic maximal-set inclusion-exclusion and explicit formulas for cycles and combs; it does not state an all-n sunlet coefficient formula. Rather (2026, §7) supplies exactly the n=6 sunlet polynomial, which is credited and not claimed new, but no general n coefficient theorem. The geodesic cyclic-gap classification and polynomial-time marked-root/pair/triple coefficient formulas resolve all n and all cardinalities. The 2026 survey and closely ranked published windmill-graph polynomial record do not cover that claim; residual unindexed overlap remains possible.
residual_risks: Search-based novelty cannot exclude an implicit formula in a less obviously titled earlier work on geodesic subsets of unicyclic graphs.
The n=6 vector and its failure of log-concavity were explicitly published in 2026 and are not asserted as novel.
No universal unimodality or log-concavity statement is proved here.

value.rationale: All-cardinality general-position enumeration of the entire natural sunlet family C_n corona K_1 fills the cycle-corona gap left after the 2024 path-corona/comb results. The central structural gap test and O(n^4) integer arithmetic evaluation go beyond previously known scalar parameters or the published isolated n=6 case, providing complete distributions for an infinite unicyclic graph family. The result is meaningful without resolving the separate open corona-unimodality problem.
